d:
Bihar ke patna ka bhikhna pahari lanbe samay se pratiyogi parikshaon ki taiyari karne vale yuvaon ka pramukh thikana raha hai. yahan bihar hi nahin, balki alag-alag ilakon se chhatr sivil sarvisej, bihar lok seva aayog, karmachari chayan aayog aur dusri pratiyogi parikshaon ki taiyari karne pahunchte hain.
